01运行前的观察目标02逐项检查三维张量的线性投影03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

projection 为 (2, 3, 4) -> (2, 3, 2)；reshape equals permute 为 False；第一个样本池化后是 [4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0]。

python 01_tensor_demo.py环境配置

逐项检查三维张量的线性投影

01_tensor_demo.py
import torch torch.manual_seed(0)# STEP 1: 用不相同的轴长度，让错误更容易暴露B, T, D, O = 2, 3, 4, 2x = torch.arange(B * T * D, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(B, T, D)W = torch.randn(D, O)bias = torch.tensor([0.1, -0.2])y = x @ W + biasassert y.shape == (B, T, O)# einsum 直接在式子中标注被求和的 d 轴y_check = torch.einsum("btd,do->bto", x, W) + biasassert torch.allclose(y, y_check)print("projection:", tuple(x.shape), "->", tuple(y.shape)) # STEP 2: 交换轴不是重新切分内存xt = x.permute(0, 2, 1)assert xt[1, 2, 0] == x[1, 0, 2]assert torch.equal(xt.permute(0, 2, 1), x)wrong = x.reshape(B, D, T)print("reshape equals permute:", torch.equal(wrong, xt))print("permuted is contiguous:", xt.is_contiguous()) # STEP 3: 每个样本的权重显式占据 B 轴sample_weight = torch.tensor([1.0, 2.0])[:, None, None]weighted = x * sample_weightassert torch.equal(weighted[0], x[0])assert torch.equal(weighted[1], x[1] * 2)pooled = x.mean(dim=1)assert pooled.shape == (B, D)print("pooled first sample:", pooled[0].tolist())
